Our accounting team also needs an updated invoice that shows the net credit and VAT handling for the EU entity (DataSentinel B.V.).

Important details:
- Current billing cycle: monthly, period 2027-05-01 -> 2027-05-31
- Seat change effective: 2027-05-11 (removal of 25 seats)
- Payment method: existing corporate credit card on file (last 4: 4321)
- Billing entity / VAT ID: DataSentinel B.V. / NL123456789B01 (please include on adjusted invoice)

I'm attaching a short signed seat_change_request.pdf from our procurement team. The accounting lead (Oliver) is cc'd — he's responsible for reconciliation. We need the tax proof and amended invoice by EOD Friday if possible — auditors are preparing a reconciliation.

Thanks,
Laura Jennings

DataSentinel B.V.

Subject: Re: Mid-period seat reduction — effective 2027-05-11 (VAT details attached)

Hi Laura — thanks for the heads up and for sending the signed request. Forwarding to accounting (Marcus) to produce the proration and updated invoice.

Quick notes so we're aligned:
- We'll calculate a per-seat daily rate based on the committed seats for May and credit the unused portion from 2027-05-11 through 2027-05-31 (inclusive).
- Credits will be applied as a negative line item on an updated May invoice and then posted as a credit to your account. We can either refund to the card on file or leave as a credit to offset June charges — which would you prefer?
- For VAT: since DataSentinel B.V. provided an EU VAT ID, we will mark the amended invoice accordingly. Marcus will confirm if reverse-charge applies or if we need to reissue with VAT at 21% depending on the billing entity recorded.

Action requested from you: please confirm whether you want a refund to the card (4321) or a credit applied to next month. If refund, allow 5-7 business days after processing.

I'll aim to get a provisional proration calculation within the day.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(sean_gallagher@redwood.example)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.example <marcus_lin@redwood.example>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.example, kimberly_park@redwood.example
Cc: Laura Jennings <laura.jennings@datasentinel.co>, Oliver Marks <oliver.marks@datasentinel.co>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:47:00 +0200
Subject: RE: Mid-period seat reduction — provisional proration and VAT handling

Hi all — provisional numbers attached (proration_calc.xlsx) and a draft adjusted invoice (invoice_Draft_345.pdf). Summary below.

Summary of calculation (provisional):
- May monthly list price per seat (committed tier): EUR 120.00 / seat / month
- Daily rate per seat = 120.00 / 31 = EUR 3.8709677419
- Seats active for May before change: 120 seats (full month)
- Seats active after 2027-05-11: 95 seats starting 2027-05-11 -> unused seats: 25 seats for 21 days (11th - 31st inclusive)
- Unused seat-days = 25 seats * 21 days = 525 seat-days
- Credit = 525 * EUR 3.8709677419 = EUR 2,034.68 (rounded to 2 decimals)

VAT handling (EU):
- We have recorded DataSentinel B.V. with VAT ID NL123456789B01 in our billing system. For B2B supplies across the EU where the buyer provides a valid VAT number, reverse charge typically applies and VAT on Redwood's invoice is zero-rated; the buyer (DataSentinel) accounts for VAT in their jurisdiction.
- We will mark the adjusted invoice as reverse-charge zero-rate. However, because this is a credit (negative line item) the wording needs to explicitly reference the original invoice number and the VAT treatment — see draft invoice attached. Please confirm the VAT ID and billing entity name exactly as you want it to appear.

Next steps:
1) Laura: confirm refund vs credit application and confirm exact billing name for invoice footer.
2) Sean / Kimberly: if approved, I'll finalize and issue the adjusted invoice and create the refund/credit.

Attachments: proration_calc.xlsx (calculation worksheet), invoice_Draft_345.pdf (draft adjusted invoice).

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
(attachment: proration_calc.xlsx, invoice_Draft_345.pdf)

We approve:
- Please refund the EUR 2,034.68 to the corporate card on file (last 4: 4321).
- Invoice footer should read: DataSentinel B.V., Handelsregister 87654321, VAT NL123456789B01.
- Please mark the amended invoice as "Credit memo referencing Invoice #345" and include reverse-charge note: "VAT reverse charge: Article 194 (EU VAT Directive) — customer liable for VAT."

Can you expedite? Our finance team needs the final PDF and evidence of the refund to attach to their reconciliation packet. If you can confirm processing today, we'll wait; otherwise please advise ETA.

Best,
Laura Jennings

DataSentinel B.V.
